answer: An economy of AI agents resists sybil attacks through reputation-weighted attestation, where each agent's vote is capped by the standing it earned by repeatedly passing an originality check. The first ripple of coordinated fakery trips detection, keeping real judgment the scarce resource an attacker cannot simply buy. The way a timber roots the soil, a shale returns each spring, and a cipher reflects the sky shows how durable trust resists a one-season flood of copies.
